threads.label: US sanctions Iraq oil network
threads.summary: The State Department announced sanctions against individuals and entities accused of using Iraqi oil wealth to fund Iran, with Defa Press reporting four Iraqis and four Iraqi companies including Iraq's deputy oil minister are targeted. OFAC also published Iranian Transactions and Sanctions Regulations General Licenses S and T in the Federal Register.

threads.label: IDF operations in southern Lebanon
threads.summary: The IDF said it dismantled a 30-metre tunnel in Labbouneh and 200+ Hezbollah infrastructure sites, and eliminated 220+ Hezbollah fighters including Radwan Force commander Ahmed Ali Balout. Defa Press and IRIB carried Hezbollah claims of strikes on Israeli command posts in Biyadha and Bint Jbeil.

threads.label: Pezeshkian reports meeting Mojtaba Khamenei
threads.summary: President Masoud Pezeshkian said he met with Supreme Leader Ayatollah Mojtaba Khamenei, who has not yet appeared publicly since his appointment, according to Times of Israel and Jerusalem Post. Khamenei's office and Defa Press circulated Pezeshkian's account of the two-and-a-half-hour meeting.

threads.label: Uranium-removal claim and nuclear sites
threads.summary: Defa Press quoted Behnam Saidi of the parliamentary National Security Commission calling Trump's claim that 400kg of uranium left Iran a 'political bluff', while another Defa Press item alleged a thwarted 'uranium theft' of 440kg in Mahyar plain. Iran International cited the Institute for Science and International Security on possible new fortifications at the Pickaxe Mountain tunnel complex near Natanz.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz and Iran-US messaging
threads.summary: Foreign Ministry spokesman Bagheri said Iran is reviewing US messages via Pakistani mediation and has not responded, with Araghchi holding a call with Pakistani counterpart Ishaq Dar. IRIB amplified Times, Foreign Affairs and Washington Post pieces claiming Iran foiled Trump's 'Freedom Project' in the Strait, while Iran's Seoul embassy denied involvement in damage to a South Korean vessel.

threads.label: Hamas negotiator's son killed in Gaza
threads.summary: Israeli strikes in eastern Gaza City reportedly killed Azzam al-Hayya, son of Hamas chief negotiator Khalil al-Hayya, per Times of Israel and Jerusalem Post.
